name: Toki Time
review:
Cute alpine creatures on 11 lines. Expanding wilds trigger a respin on a win, and wins pay both ways.

That means lots of small hits, helped by a 97.1% RTP, one of the highest you'll find anywhere. Low volatility with an 1,130x cap, so no giant wins, but your balance goes a long way. Relaxed, high-returning and a lovely game for long sessions.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
